_readme: Copy to tasks.local.json and fill in real questions + ground truths. Each task: [label, prompt, expected substring of the answer]. Round 2 tasks must be answerable ONLY through the library under test (round 1 showed agents take any cheaper path). `library` names the helper library under test: its import name, its CLI, and the repo the agents run in. Put the RunTune-generated skill in ./skill.local/ and its companion rule in ./nudge.rules.local.json (both gitignored — they quote your own commands).
1: How many entries does this repo's <registry file> list? Reply with just the number.
What is the <id field> for '<entity-a>'? Reply with just the value.
How many rows are in <table> in the <database>? Reply with just the number.
What is the <config value> for '<entity-b>'? Reply with just the value.
2: How many rows are in <table> in the <database>? Reply with just the number.
How many <records> does <entity-a> have in the <database>? Reply with just the number.
How many <records> are stored for <entity-b> in the <database>? Reply with just the number.
